fields.summary_ko.0: Amazon.com's AWS division is experiencing rapid growth from expanded AI infrastructure demand, though a substantial portion of recent net income gains stems from mark-to-market gains on Anthropic holdings, necessitating assessment of AWS actual cash generation.
fields.summary_ko.1: Amazon's fair value is set at $280.21, with the key judgment point being whether annual capital expenditures of $22 billion can be sufficiently offset by AWS revenue and cash generation.
